senses.gloss: (cmp. דַּף) to hammer, force into a groove &c.—Part. pass. דָּפוּן, f. דְּפוּנָה.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 2:3">Kel. II, 3</cite> <he>חבית ד׳ וכ׳</he> an attachment in the shape of a jar fitted into the projecting rims of a vessel (to serve as a handle).

senses.gloss: to force, enforce the law against. Sifra Emor ch. I מנין אם לא רצה דַּפְּנוֹ whence do we prove the rule, ‘If he refuses (to dismiss her), force him’; Yeb. 88ᵇ מנין שאם וכ׳ (read אם).
units: <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 629">Ib.</cite> <he>דפנו בעדים</he> proceed against him by procuring counter-evidence.
